messages:
Oncall Bot: PAGER: billing-metering anomaly detected. token_counter.delta > 25% vs 1h baseline in prod us-west-2. Possible delayed emits and duplicate counts. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/metering-drift 

Emma (SRE): acked, I'm jumping in. seeing the alert in grafana, spike around 10:12 UTC and a trailing delta. starting triage. 

Raj (Billing): adding context — we already have a few customers who got automated overage flags this morning. need to confirm whether flags are real or false positives. customer emails queued via billing-notify. 

Maria (Support): any quick list of impacted accounts so we can pause outbound emails? I can open a temp case and hold notifications. 

Tomas (Eng): initial quick check: kafka-consumer lag on meter-ingest-consumer is ~120k msgs at 10:15, consumer offsets look stuck intermittently. suspect consumer restart that reprocessed some messages -> duplicate aggregates. pulling logs now. 

Emma (SRE): good catch. can we confirm duplicate ingestion? run this query against metering-delta table: 
```sql
SELECT customer_id, count(*), min(ts), max(ts)
FROM metering.events
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-15T09:45:00Z'
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING count(*) > expected_count_threshold
ORDER BY count(*) DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

Tomas (Eng): running. also checking dedupe-job status. dedupe-worker shows repeated restarts in the last 10m: 
```
kubectl -n metering get pods -l app=dedupe-worker
kubectl -n metering logs dedupe-worker-5f9b -c dedupe
```
Output shows OOMKilled then restart loop. likely missed heartbeat and reprocessed window. 

Raj (Billing): if dedupe-job restarted, that could have re-inserted events and caused overcount. Impact: usage reporting inflated for some customers. We should stop billing-notify until we confirm. 

Maria (Support): pausing billing-notify now. Command: `scripts/ops/pause-billing-notify --reason "metering drift - pause"`. Done — support-confirmed. :white_check_mark: 

Oncall Bot: Action logged: pause-billing-notify by Maria at 10:28 UTC. Incident channel: #incidents. 

Emma (SRE): mitigation plan: 1) scale dedupe-worker to 0 replicas to stop further reprocessing, 2) trigger a backfill verification job to compute canonical counts, 3) hold customer-facing emails until counts reconciled. I'll run the scale. 

Tomas (Eng): scaling down dedupe-worker: 
```
kubectl -n metering scale deployment/dedupe-worker --replicas=0
```
Scaled. Confirmed no new restarts. 

Emma (SRE): running quick sanity check on token counter aggregation microservice: `curl -s http://metrics-agg.internal/health` returns 200 but tail logs show repeated "window-commit mismatch" errors at 10:13->10:22. 

Raj (Billing): noted. I'll compile a short customer-impact spreadsheet with affected account IDs and provisional delta so support can triage whether to retract overage flags. 

Maria (Support): thanks. template for retraction message please (so we don't accidentally confirm incorrect overages). 

Raj (Billing): draft: "We detected an anomaly in our usage processing that caused temporary, incorrect overage notifications. We're investigating and will follow up with corrected invoices if applicable. No action required on your part currently." Will post once we confirm which customers. 

Tomas (Eng): the root cause trace so far: dedupe-worker OOM -> restart -> consumer reprocessing a 10m window without correct offsets -> duplicate writes into metering.delta table -> billing pipeline picked up higher counts -> overage flags. We need to validate whether writes were idempotent. 

Emma (SRE): running idempotency check: grep logs for duplicate event IDs across writes, and cross-check with primary key constraint violations. If duplicates found, we can compute delta corrections by aggregating unique event_ids per customer/time-window. 

BillingServiceBot: automated alert: billing-emit-queue length decreased to baseline after scale. snapshot: token_count drift reduced from +27% to +3% over baseline. 

Emma (SRE): preliminary reconciliation job launched (job-id rj-3123). will run overnight full diff; will publish a short report in the morning with exact corrected deltas. For now, we keep billing-notify paused. 

Maria (Support): update for customers: I'm drafting a hold message: "We're aware of inaccurate overage emails and have paused notifications while we fix the issue. We'll follow up with corrected usage statements by EOD or earlier." Will hold until Raj signs off. 

Raj (Billing): signed off on messaging. please include a support link and a contact for high-priority accounts. 

Emma (SRE): next steps / owners: 
- Emma (SRE): run full dedupe/uniq aggregation and produce correction csv (rj-3123) 
- Tomas (Eng): postmortem on dedupe-worker OOM root cause (possibly mem leak), patch & deploy fix to prevent restarts 
- Raj (Billing): prepare customer list and coordinate retraction/re-notify plan 
- Maria (Support): hold notifications, prepare templates, and standby for customer escalations 

Emma (SRE): current status: mitigations applied (dedupe-worker scaled, billing-notify paused), monitoring shows counts stabilizing. Not paging further. Willing to hand off but staying on for verification. 

Oncall Bot: Incident severity downgraded to P2 at 10:45 UTC. No active pager. 

Tomas (Eng): quick note — I found a trove of large GC pauses in dedupe-worker container logs pre-OOM. pushing a memory cap bump and adding a liveness probe to avoid partial window commit on restart. PR coming: https://redwood/pull/5241 

Emma (SRE): handing off to next oncall at 11:00 UTC. Handoff checklist: current mitigations, rj-3123 job running, billing-notify paused, PR linked for fix, monitoring alerts in place (token_counter_delta > 10% re-pager). 

Maria (Support): summarizing for ops post: impacted customers list in #support-ops once Raj posts. I'll open a ticket for proactive outreach. 

Raj (Billing): uploading spreadsheet to drive and will DM support channel link. Still verifying edge cases where genuine usage + duplicate overlapped. 

Emma (SRE): last note — if anyone sees token_count spike again, please escalate immediately. Leaving channel open for a bit. 

Oncall Bot: Handoff recorded. Next oncall: Sam (SRE) at 11:00 UTC. Thread closed for active paging at 10:50 UTC.
